desc: Ganju possesses a hot temper, a strong ego and a deep hatred for Shinigami. This grudge is slow to dissipate even after he learns the truth of the incident. Though he always acts tough, he has shown that he also has a softer side, easily being cowed by his older sister Kūkaku.
name: Ganju Shiba

desc: Izuru is a gloomy and introspective person, not easily able to socialize with others. He generally appears weak and indifferent, leading many to believe he lacks the ability to be a leader.
name: Iziru Kira

desc: Ōmaeda is an arrogant and dull man. He is cowardly, loud, vain, elitist, snobbish, greedy and sluggish. However, he is exceedingly loyal to his captain to the point that he is willing to fight along with his captain against enemies much stronger than himself.
name: Marechiyo Ōmaeda

desc: Yumichika is a narcissist who judges almost everyone and everything by beauty. He is also incredibly vain. Yumichika is a powerful combatant and wanted to become the third Seat of his Division, as he thought the kanji for the number three was the most beautiful.
name: Yumichika Ayasegawa

desc: Lieutenant Kurotsuchi Nemu is an artificial entity created from the Gigai technology and Gikon technology by Captain Kurotsuchi. The same blood flows in Nemu and Captain Kurotsuchi, hence be it interest or how to spend free time, she will have many similarities as Captain Kurotsuchi.
name: Nemu Kurotsuchi

desc: Sado is a quiet person and is sometimes the subject of jokes or bullies because he never fights back. Nonetheless, he is treated equally within his group of friends in Karakura.
name: Yasutora Sado

desc: Kaien Shiba is the former lieutenant of the 13th Division, under Jūshirō Ukitake, up until his death at the hands of a Hollow that also killed his wife, Miyako Shiba. He was the brother of Kūkaku and Ganju.
name: Kaien Shiba

desc: Orihime is independent, friendly, humorous, sensitive, caring and kind. She comes off as naive and rather clueless, which is at odds with her exceptionally high marks in school.
name: Orihime Inoue

desc: Yachiru is childlike in most aspects - she is small, cheerful, energetic and carefree most of the time. She is often seen latched onto the back of her captain, Kenpachi Zaraki, just over his left shoulder and is somewhat territorial about this position.
name: Yachiru Kusajishi

desc: Renji is quite dynamic. His personality varies from smug and cocky to disquieted and depressed after a major defeat, but shows himself to be an incredibly serious and determined fighter when confronted with an actual threat.
name: Renji Abarai

desc: In comparison to her comrades, Lisa is one of the calmer, more sensible members of the Visored, showing a quite stern, detached and secretive demeanor at most points, although she is somewhat temperamental and easily irritable.
name: Lisa Yadoumaru

desc: Initially born into a lower class, Rukia retains her modesty, even as an adopted member of the nobility. She is graceful and "clean", yet chooses to talk to ordinary people. However, her cool and lone demeanor often forces her to hide her personal troubles, even from her friends.
name: Rukia Kuchiki

desc: Momo is generally an upbeat, easy-going, and friendly girl. She has a strong friendship with Tōshirō Hitsugaya, whom she grew up with, repeatedly calling him "Shirō-chan", despite his higher rank and complaints about this.
name: Momo Hinamori

desc: Shinji is somewhat comical, adding a bit of levity to situations that are otherwise serious. He has a flippant attitude under normal circumstances and seems to like annoying his associate, Hiyori Sarugaki, which usually earns him a slap from one of her sandals.
name: Visored Hirako

desc: Komamura is an anthropomorphic wolf, although he is often mistaken for a dog. Initially, he was very self-conscious about his appearance, so he wore gloves with bracers, as well as a helmet, to conceal his entire body.
name: Komamura Sajin

desc: Kensei is a serious and decisive individual, though he is easily annoyed and is rather temperamental, often to a fault. He is greatly annoyed by immaturity, evident when Orihime infiltrates the Visored's hideout and jokingly asks where the bathroom is; Kensei is noticeably annoyed, only calming down when Lisa Yadōmaru and Love Aikawa remind him that it was only a joke
name: Kensei Muguruma

desc: Harribel is calm, taciturn, level-headed, and analytical, preferring to not engage in combat: she is content with silently observing both parties until the fighting reaches its conclusion.
name: Harribel

desc: Yoruichi is intelligent and witty, holding an intimate knowledge of Soul Society and its workings, as she was the former leader of the Onmitsukidō and the Second Division's captain. Although of noble birth, she acts differently from most other nobles, very much like Kaien Shiba.
name: Shihōin Yoruichi

desc: Kisuke Urahara is the former captain of the 12th Division, as well as the founder and 1st President of the Shinigami Research and Development Institute. He currently lives in the Human World after being exiled, where he owns a small convenience store, "Urahara Shop", which doubles in selling Shinigami items.
name: Kisuke Urahara

desc: Ikkaku is violent, fight-loving, and rude, which has been noted by Tetsuzaemon Iba, among others. He loves fighting so much, he is unwilling to travel anywhere without a sword, resorting to carrying a wooden one when posing as a student at Karakura High School.
name: Ikkaku Madarame

desc: Tōsen has dark skin and dark brown braids. He has pupil-less eyes that are a pale lavender and has been blind since birth. He was the captain of the 9th Division of the Gotei 13 until he betrayed Soul Society, alongside Sōsuke Aizen and Gin Ichimaru.
name: Kaname Tōsen

desc: Kyōraku is a laid-back and flamboyant man, evident in his style of dress and general attitude, and is rarely seen without a smile. In his off time, he often drinks sake in bars and naps. Other times, he likes to chase after women.
name: Shunsui Kyōraku

desc: Ukitake is well-respected and highly honorable, and always treats those around him with respect, even those who are weaker or not as highly ranked as he is. As a result, he can be easily approached by other members of Soul Society who seek favors or advice from the captain.
name: Jūshirō Ukitake

desc: Byakuya Kuchiki is the 28th head of the Kuchiki Clan, one of the four great noble clans in Soul Society. He is also the captain of the 6th Division in the Gotei 13, and his lieutenant is Renji Abarai.
name: Byakuya Kuchiki

desc: Although he is known to be a violent fighter, Kenpachi's actions tend to be for the best. He has a very poor sense of direction, at times asking Yachiru for help (even though her sense of direction is just as bad). Kenpachi lives for battle, and enjoys a good fight more than anything.
name: Kenpachi Zaraki

desc: Personality-wise, Nnoitra is extremely rude and lecherous, accented by his snake-like eyes and perverted attitude towards Orihime, rudely referring to her as "pet-sama".
name: Nnoitra Gilga

desc: Retsu Unohana,formerly known as Yachiru Unohana, was the captain of the Fourth Division in the Gotei 13. She was one of the oldest and most experienced captains, and was the Soul Society's best healer, as well as the first person to wield the name Kenpachi.
name: Retsu Unohana

desc: Baraggan has the appearance of an elderly man, with a white mustache and white hair. His face is lined by large scars on the left side of his chin and across his right eye. Despite his aged appearance, Baraggan is quite stocky and muscular.
name: Baraggan Louisenbairn

desc: Gin Ichimaru was the captain of the 3rd Division of the Gotei 13 until he betrayed Soul Society. He is a very mysterious man, since his almost constant smile and slitted eyes, combined with his heavy use of sarcasm and mocking politeness, make it very difficult to discern his thoughts.
name: Gin Ichimaru

desc: Suì-Fēng is the commander-in-chief of the Onmitsukidō and the captain of the 2nd Division in the Gotei 13.
name: Suì-Fēng

desc: Starrk has blue-gray eyes and wavy, dark brown hair, which ends at the base of his neck, is always unkempt, and is parted down the middle. He has a faded goatee.
name: Coyote Starrk

desc: Ichigo, who becomes Shinigami, wears the Hollowed Visor and greatly increases in battle capabilities.
name: Hollowed Ichigo

desc: He followed his grandfather's footsteps and become a Quincy, very strong spiritual power.
name: Quincy Uryū

Prior to his departure from Soul Society, Aizen appeared as a mild-featured man with brown scholarly hair enhanced by square glasses, along with soft brown eyes.

Being born from the siblings who erased all of Rukia's memories, Dark Rukia retains none of her former personality and instead seems to be dominated entirely by a fusion of Homura and Shizuku's consciousness.
name: Dark Rukia

desc: The Shikai form of Renji. Zabimaru transforms into an even longer 6-part segmented blade; each segment is wider than the one preceding it from the hilt, with 2 pick-like protrusions on the front and back of each segment, with the ones on the front much longer than the ones on the back.
name: Zabimaru Renji

desc: Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto was the captain of the 1st Division in the Gotei 13 and also the Captain-Commander (Head-Captain in the English Dub) of the whole Gotei 13. His lieutenant was Chōjirō Sasakibe. He led the core of Gotei 13 to defeat Aizen and his arrancar army, in the process losing his left arm.
name: Yamamoto Genryūsai Shigekuni

desc: Isane is a tall, young looking woman with gray eyes and short messy silver hair with strands on the right side of her face that are shoulder-length and styled as two thin braids. She wears a thin dangling red earring on each ear and a standard Shinigami uniform with her lieutenant badge on her left arm.
name: Isane Kotetsu

desc: Kurotsuchi Mayuri is the 12th Division Captain of The Gotei 13 and the 2nd minister of technology R&D department. Besides, he is the author of medical column "cerebral tonic" of Seireitei communication set.
name: Kurotsuchi Mayuri

desc: The ultimate form of Ichigo's zanpakuto which defeated Aizen.
name: Mugetsu

desc: Before joining Gotei 13, she is the most fearsome villain in Soul Society. She named herself - Kenpachi.
name: Retsu Unohana Kenpachi

desc: Ichigo in his Hogyoku-kai form, the heat and Reiatsu made Zangetsu a twin blade.
name: True-Shikai Ichigo

desc: After Byakuya's incentive and reminder,Rukia determination to regain fighting,she successed to cast Bankai and defeat the enemy,the Bankai is called the Hakka no Togame.
name: Bankai Rukia

desc: Silver short mid-parting hair, with a glass on his deep bluish eyes, he reminded people around of Ishida.
name: Ishida Ryūken

desc: Renji with reddish blue hair and large tattoo above his eyebrow. Also there're similar tattoos on his body.
name: Berserk Renji

desc: Shinigami Kensei is an irritable muscular man wearing a tank top.
name: Shinigami Kensei

desc: Kirinji is a lean-built and very tall man with black hair arranged into an outlandishly large pompadour, or "regent" hairstyle, with tapered sideburns. He is frequently seen chewing upon a small stick. Instead of the standard Shinigami uniform, he wears a waist-length white jacket that leaves most of his chest exposed but still bears the Royal Guard emblem on its back, as well as the alternating circle and diamond pattern of a captain's haori along the bottom.
name: Kirinji Tenjirō

desc: Yhwach is a tall man with long black hair and black beard. He has fierce appearance and reddish-brown eyes. He always wears a dark red cloak. Both sides of his coat have three silver medals.
name: Yhwach

desc: Kirio Hikifune is a former captain of the 12th Division and a member of the Royal Guard, holding the title "Kokuō".
name: Hikifune Kirio

desc: Nimaiya is a dark-skinned man with thick, black hair that is shaven and dyed green on the sides of his head. He wears a variation of the Shinigami shihakushō, featuring instead a green undergarment, and a shortened hakama that exposes his lower legs. Worn over this is a white, sleeveless puffer jacket that bears the Royal Guard emblem on its back, as well as the alternating circle and diamond pattern of a captain's haori along the bottom.
name: Ōetsu Nimaiya

desc: Ichibē is a large and broad individual with a bald head, red eyes, bushy eyebrows and a long black beard. He wears the standard Shinigami uniform beneath a white, long-sleeved haori decorated with the Royal Guard's emblem.
name: Ichibē Hyōsube

desc: Senjumaru has the appearance of a slender and very youthful woman with fair skin and long, black hair that is adorned at the back by a large golden ornament in the shape of a crescent moon with numerous small lines radiating outwards.
name: Senjumaru Shutara

desc: He is a former 3rd Seat of the 6th Division who later revolted against the Seireitei. He was also a member of the Kuchiki Clan, having married into it.
name: Kōga Kuchiki

desc: Kūkaku is youthful-looking woman of average height. She has green eyes and wears bandages over her long messy black hair that parts down in half at the small of her back.
name: Sexy Kūkaku

desc: She is a woman of few words. She is slender, youthful and loyal to Kurotsuchi Mayuri.
name: Shy Nemu

desc: Retsu Unohana is the captain of the Fourth Division in the Gotei 13. She is one of the oldest and most experienced captains.Unohana has the appearance of a slender and very youthful woman with blue eyes and black hair.
name: Elegant Unohana

desc: Despite she's always timid and shy , her personality differs a lot when fighting.
name: Noble Isane

desc: Toshiro is the captain of the 10th Division in the Gotei 13.He is relatively young by Shinigami standards, and has the appearance of a child.
name: Handsome Toshiro

desc: Yachiru Kusajishi is the lieutenant of the 11th Division in the Gotei 13, under Captain Kenpachi Zaraki, as well as the President of the Shinigami Women's Association.
name: Delicate Yachiru

desc: An emotional guy who used to thinking thoroughly and calmly.
name: Gentle Byakuya

desc: Bambietta is a slender young girl with long, straight, dark brown hair and brown eyes. Her attire is a variation of the Sternritter's typical white uniform, consisting of the order's signature hooded-cloak, a thigh-length trench coat, knee-high boots, a miniskirt, and black stockings with a red trim on her gloves and boots.
name: Bambietta Basterbine

desc: Youruichi under Shunko form, who acts with free will and releases totally different reiatsu that changes 48 times each second.
name: Raijin Yoruichi

desc: After the grand war, Aizen, who was sealed at that time, was transferred to the Central 46 for an 18,800-year sentence. Then the duration was extended to 20,000 years due to his disdain to the law.
name: Muken Aizen

desc: Jugram Haschwalth is a Quincy and the Wandenreich's Sternritter Grandmaster. He is also the advisor to Emperor Yhwach and the substitute as the monarch when Yhwach sleeps, as well as the second-in-command of the Wandenreich.[5] Yhwach refers to him as his "other half".
name: Haschwalth

desc: We're devoured by the inevitable fear and ignorance, those who evaded are the chosen ones to fulfill the destiny.
name: Bankai Urahara

desc: Komamura gives up his heart in exchange for his indestructible human form and Bankai via werewolf's Humanization Technique.

desc: Guided by Kusajishi, Kenpachi's skin turned red and became invulnerable by using his Bankai.
name: Bankai Kenpachi

desc: In battle against Shihōin, Suì-Fēng has mastered Shunkō and continues to practice for perfection. Swirls of wind will circle around her till the end of fight.
name: Shunkō Suì-Fēng

desc: Genryūsai, top Shinigami in a thousand year,  has mastered  Bankai Ryūjin Jakka: Zanka no Tachi. He can erase any enemies by a mere touch of  blade and cover himself with raging flame so no offender can come close to the sword holder. This is the most powerful Bankai.
name: Bankai Genryūsai

desc: Shin Daiguren Tōshirō is the completed form of Tōshirō's Bankai power with mature look and shape. The unleashed Daiguren Hyōrinmaru can freeze everything to death in a few seconds.
name: Shin Daiguren Tōshirō

desc: Bazz-B is a member of the Wandenreich's Sternritter, with the designation "H" - "The Heat", which means he can control fire in battle just like his hot-headed personality.  He keeps his purple hair in a long Mohawk and he is a friend of  Haschwalth since childhood.
name: Bazz-B

desc: Gerard Valkyrie is a member of the Wandenreich's Sternritter with the designation "M" - The Miracle.  His body is resilient enough to recover from multiple fatal attack and this makes him the indestructible deity.
name: Valkyrie

desc:
The Captain-Commander of the Gotei 13. He lost his right eye in the battle with Wandenreich. 
Upon his Bankai Bones of Heavenly Blooming Madness·Withering Pine Lovers' Suicide release, 
an aura covers a large area around Shunsui. This aura changes others' perception of the 
surrounding environment, making them perceive it as darkened, bleak and gloomy, and causes

desc: A Fullbringer and a former member of Xcution. Tsukishima is cold and collected in most things he does. His ability "Book of the End" can insert him into the target's past without hurting the opponent and change the target's memory.

desc: A Fullbringer and member of Xcution. Riruka is an impatient and hot-tempered young girl who loves donuts and cute things. She likes Ichigo.

desc: With the help of XCUTION members, Ichigo utilize Substitute Shinigami Badge to release his Clad Type FullBring Form. In this form, he obtained amazing speed, and able to use Getsuga Tenshō against enemies.

desc: Mayuri is the 12th Division Captain in Gotei 13, 2nd President of the Shinigami Research Institutes. He has weird personality and personifies the stereotype of the mad scientist. In Royal Realm, he faught against Pernida Parnkgjas with Nemu Kurotsuchi.

desc: Inherits every Naruto [Sage Mode] skill except Sage Jutsu Shadow Clone. Its Standard Attack is always Sage Art - Rasengan Barrage. Lightning-resistant.
name: Sage Jutsu Shadow Clone

desc: Fire / Senjutsu. SSS Assaulter. Toad Esophagus, Extreme Chaos and 15-hit Chase.
name: Jiraiya [Toads Chant]

desc: SSS Vanguard / Front Row. Wood Style and Kamui. Two Standards every round. Once per battle below 50% HP: enter Rage and recover 50% max HP. Rage grants enhanced Mystery, Standards and Chases, 12% Life Steal, enhanced Kamui at the beginning of every round (no cooldown) and one additional Standard after defeating an enemy with a Standard. Deals physical damage, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF.
name: Uchiha Obito [Rage Mode]

desc: SSS Assaulter / Middle Row. Akatsuki, Rinnegan. Outer Path - Six Paths of Pain: up to 5 Technique Points, each increases Attack and Ninjutsu by 12%. Gain 0.5 point whenever attacked. First defeat per battle: revive with 100% HP, lose ALL current skills, gain ONLY Final - Almighty Push and Final - The One called God. The One called God: every damage event scales Attack by 12%; Critical Hits inflict Chakra Disruption II. Cancel incoming Debuffs except Level 2; each cancellation increases Initiative by 2%, stacking up to 5. Horror II (Fear): cannot Standard Attack or receive external Buffs, stat increases or Shields until next round end or the affected unit executes a Mystery. Deals physical damage, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF.
name: Pain - Tendo [Six Paths Rinnegan]

desc: SSS. Any formation position: front, middle or rear. Wood Style / Senjutsu. Chakra Burst: first damage each round grants Excited Mode (Attack/Ninjutsu +60%, Defense/Resistance -30%) through round end. Each damage event grants 0.5 Technique Point (max 2); Defense +20% per point. At 2 points consume all, recover 40 Chakra, enter Burst. Base Senjutsu: immune to Debuffs, heal 25% max HP and Mystery cooldown -1 whenever damaged. Burst: advanced immunity, Fire immunity, +30% damage, defense penetration on Chases; living Burst Hashirama grants allies +3% Attack/Ninjutsu stacks whenever they deal respective damage. Each activation and deactivation of Burst adds permanent stacking +10% Mystery damage. End of round: leave Burst, activate Deep Forest and Explosive Mode for 2 rounds. Under the forest, Explosive units using Mysteries inflict Root Binding II on hit targets for the round (cannot Standard, Defense/Resistance fixed to 100% base). Deity Gate Seal II: cannot Mystery, guaranteed Critical Hits locked to 1.5x for the round. Weakness II: Attack/Ninjutsu fixed to 75% base through stated duration. Any formation position. Mysteries: 3/2 round recovery, Chakra 20/40; Chase twice per round; additional skill once per round. Deals physical damage, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF.
name: Hashirama Senju [The Final Battle]

desc: SSS. Any formation position: front, middle or rear. Mechanical ninja. Immune to Debuffs. Each executed action grants +8% Critical Rate and +15% Physical ATK, up to 6 triggers per round; growth persists through battle. Jet has a high chance to evade one ordinary attack per round and a 45% chance to evade Chases. On evade, recover 20 Chakra and trigger Extreme Beam, up to 3 times per round, even while controlled. Any formation position. Unspecified high chances are configured as 60%. After Chakra Bomb, permanently replace all base skills with Tailed Beast Mode: Energy Recovery (Mystery), additional Chakra Bomb, even-round Claw Strike and odd-round Tail Sweep; no base Standards, Rasengan, Jet or Technology triggers remain. Super Armor and Debuff immunity. Each Kurama Trigger grants +20% Physical ATK, stacking. Attacks received reduce Mystery recovery by 1. Energy Recovery activates permanent Explosive Mode: damaging enemies gain up to four Inflammation stacks; each physical action costs them 1% max HP per stack. All attack damage is physical, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF.
name: Mecha-Naruto

desc: SSS. Any formation position: front, middle or rear. Akatsuki mercenary. The first two Mystery, Trigger and Standard Attack damage instances received each round are reduced by 50%, triggering Deidara/Sasori, Pain/Konan or Hidan/Kakuzu respectively. Clears Ignition when attacked by Mystery, Fear/Discouragement when attacked by Trigger. Cancels incoming debuffs including Level 2 and grants Hiding. Critical damage grants +8% Critical Rate and heals 15% max HP, up to five times per round. While alive, attacks damaging allied Akatsuki suppress attacker immunity (Ninjutsu) or Super Armor (Taijutsu). Evading grants +12% Physical ATK up to seven times per round. Crow Clone Jutsu activates after an allied Akatsuki first action each round, greatly increasing chase evasion; chase damage grants +20% DEF/Resistance up to 100% for the round. SSS; any formation position. All attack damage is physical, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF.
name: Itachi Uchiha [Road to Ninja]

desc: SSS. Any formation position: front, middle or rear. Melee swordsman. Super Armor and debuff immunity. Two Mysteries per round; first two Mystery attacks received are reduced by 40%, first two pure Taijutsu attacks deal no damage. While alive, grants team +18% attack scaling and +7% critical rate when executing skills. Amaterasu Blaze: attacks shred own ATK/Ninjutsu 1%; damage received shreds own DEF/Resistance 2%, through next round. Electrocution suppresses 75% of Resistance this round. Disorder: first critical hit each round reduces attacker critical rate by 15% and stores 10% max-HP damage for round end. Extreme Fear blocks standards and buffs and deals 5% current HP per action (cap 3000) at round end. Static applies Level 2 Paralysis on Trigger actions, or teamwide on Mystery. All damaging actions hit all targets and use Physical ATK/DEF. All attack damage is physical, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF.
name: Sasuke Uchiha [Sasuke Shinden]

desc: SS. Any formation position: front, middle or rear. Frog Squad. Frog Squad Cooperation: whenever a Frog Squad ally executes a Chase, that ally gains 8% Physical ATK (stackable). Remains active after Nagato is defeated. Frog Squad Lead: before his first action each round, reduces his Mystery cooldown by 1 and sets his Mystery Chakra cost to 0 until the end of the round. All attack damage is physical, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF.
name: Nagato [Frog Squad]

desc: SSS. Any formation position: front, middle or rear. Swimsuit / Summer. Gaara has Super Armor. Sandstorm is followed by Sand Surfing. Whenever Gaara causes a Critical Hit, inflicts Level 2 Blindness for 1 round, preventing Standard Attacks. Level 2 Super Armor blocks Low Float, High Float, Repulse, Knockdown and lower-level Suppress Super Armor. At the beginning of every round, deals unavoidable small physical damage and Level 2 Discouragement to up to 4 front enemies. Discouragement prevents receiving external Buffs, stat increases and Shields until the end of the next round or executing a Mystery. Additional Skill after Sandstorm: unavoidable physical damage to up to 6 enemies. Suppresses Super Armor until round end and reduces each target Critical Rate by 15% (stackable). While Gaara is alive, whenever a non-Swimsuit/non-Summer unit on either team takes its first damage in a round, that unit Standard Attack damage is reduced by 50% and healing received by 40% until round end. All attack damage is physical, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF.
name: Gaara [Swimsuit]

desc: SSS. Any formation position: front, middle or rear. Water / Asian Style. Reserve Seal: immune to Debuffs. Physical damage to Tsunade has a 45% chance (75% after revival) to cause Chaos and Weakness for 1 round. First defeat revives at 100% max HP, once per battle. Legendary Sannin: Konoha-tagged allies receiving extra Standards grant Tsunade an extra Standard, at most 3 per round. While alive, the first Mystery damage received by each other Konoha-tagged ally each round cannot defeat them. Giant Katsuyu heals up to 9 allies for 25% Physical DEF and cleanses all Debuffs at the end of rounds 1, 2 and 3; after revival, becomes a selectable allied-target Mystery instead. After revival, before each Mystery summon 3 Small Katsuyu, each with 15% of Tsunade max HP; their Standard or fatal damage heals a random ally and restores the team Chakra Limit to 100. All attack damage is physical, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF.
name: Tsunade [Asian Style]

desc: SSS. Any formation position: front, middle or rear. Water / Asian Style. Reserve Seal: immune to Debuffs. Physical damage to Tsunade has a 45% chance (75% after revival) to cause Chaos and Weakness for 1 round. First defeat revives at 100% max HP, once per battle. Legendary Sannin: Konoha-tagged allies receiving extra Standards grant Tsunade an extra Standard, at most 3 per round. While alive, the first Mystery damage received by each other Konoha-tagged ally each round cannot defeat them. Giant Katsuyu heals up to 9 allies for 25% Physical DEF and cleanses all Debuffs at the end of rounds 1, 2 and 3; after revival, becomes a selectable allied-target Mystery instead. After revival, before each Mystery summon 3 Small Katsuyu, each with 15% of Tsunade max HP; their Standard or fatal damage heals a random ally and restores the team Chakra Limit to 100. All attack damage is physical, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF.
name: Small Katsuyu

desc: S+. Any formation position. Tailed Beast Coat: When causing Taijutsu damage against Naruto, the attacker will suffer Ignition. Tailed Beast Chakra - Wars: Before each round's action, recover Life based on own Physical ATK attributes. Immune to all Debuffs. Ignition: Units affected cannot receive Healings and suffer damage at the end of the round. Lasts for 1 round.
name: Naruto [Nine-Tails Chakra]
